request: Please probe for Jujutsu metadata on every descent even when all exclusion handling is switched off, so our inspector always knows which project owns a folder.

source.request: Please probe for Jujutsu metadata on every descent even when all exclusion handling is switched off, so our inspector always knows which project owns a folder.
source.settled: The ignore loader checks .jj metadata only when the selected options make that check relevant.
source.why: Unconditional metadata probes restore the irrelevant filesystem checks eliminated for searches with ignoring disabled.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored.
